name: Just Monika: A Doki Doki Literature Club Song
summary: This mod is a playable version of the music video "Just Monika" by Random Encounters. Meaning it plays like a normal mod but also has musical elements embedded in it. It was recently overhauled to have a new extended story and brand new features, such as updated sprites and backgrounds, grammatical error fixes, and much much more. [25th June 2020]
